title: Support session · {{company}}
description: A time-limited, fixed-Company support workspace. Every action is checked against your current Platform permissions.
state.contract: This session could not be verified. Its details were withheld.
state.failed: The session could not be loaded.
rail.title: Session
rail.fixed: The Company, reason, sign-in and expiry are fixed for this session.
close.title: Close this support session?
close.description: Company content is cleared immediately and this session cannot be reopened. Open a new session if more work is needed.
close.failed: The close could not be confirmed. The session status was re-read.
activity.title: Activity in this workspace
ended.inactive.title: This support session has ended
ended.inactive.description: Company content was cleared. Open a new session from the Company page to continue.
ended.ineligible.title: Delegated support is no longer available to you
ended.ineligible.description: Your current Platform permissions do not include delegated support. Company content was cleared.
area.none: Your current permissions do not include any support area for this session.
area.notGranted: This area is not available under your current permissions.
employees.title: Employees
employees.name: Name
correction.title: Correct employee details
correction.description: Only name, phone and photo can be corrected in a support session.
correction.unavailable: The current employee record could not be loaded.
outcome.invalid: Some values were rejected. Review the highlighted fields.
outcome.access-restricted: The Company access mode does not allow this change.
outcome.refused: This action is not allowed. Your access was re-checked.
outcome.stale: The record changed. The latest state was loaded; review it before trying again.
outcome.contract: The response could not be verified. Nothing was assumed.
outcome.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. The latest state was loaded; check it before trying again.
roles.title: Roles
roles.readOnly: Roles are read-only in a support session.
profile.title: Organization profile
profile.field.name: Company name
setup.title: Setup
setup.confirmDescription: The step changes for the Company immediately.
email.removeDescription: {{key}} will fall back to the default template.
audit.title: Scoped audit
diagnostics.title: Company email diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Inspect synthetic sample content using this Company’s templates and branding. No real credentials or Company users are created.
diagnostics.empty: No supported sample emails are available.
diagnostics.unavailable: This sample is unavailable in the selected language.
diagnostics.subject: Subject
diagnostics.recipient: Test delivery goes only to your registered Platform mailbox:
diagnostics.limit: Up to five new tests per Company in ten minutes. All your support sessions share this limit.
diagnostics.confirmDescription: Send the {{type}} sample in {{locale}} for this Company to {{mailbox}}. This uses synthetic content only. The server resolves your current registered mailbox; no recipient can be changed here.
diagnostics.evidence: This is delivery worker evidence, not proof of mailbox receipt.
diagnostics.outcome.unknown: Acceptance could not be confirmed. Check the result before replaying this same request.
diagnostics.outcome.notFound: No accepted receipt is visible yet. Acceptance may still be in progress. Check again, or explicitly confirm the same request; do not start a new test.
diagnostics.outcome.notReady: The Company sender is not ready. Review sending readiness before confirming this same request again.
diagnostics.outcome.conflict: This request no longer matches its accepted command or your registered mailbox. Check its result; a new send is unavailable.
diagnostics.outcome.limited: The sending limit was reached. Wait {{seconds}} seconds before confirming the same request again.
diagnostics.outcome.unprocessable: The registered mailbox or synthetic sample is unavailable. Review the configuration before confirming again.
diagnostics.outcome.refused: The request was refused. Current authority and session state were rechecked.
diagnostics.outcome.contract: The diagnostics contract could not be validated. Sending is unavailable.
ended.concealed.title: Support session unavailable
ended.concealed.description: This session could not be accessed from your current sign-in. Company content has been cleared.
rail.readOnly: Read only session. Changes need a request with Read and change access.
access.narrowedByApprover: The approver narrowed what you asked for.
access.note.requestPlaceholder: e.g. Reproduce the failed October payroll export. Ticket SUP-1234.
access.note.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. The owner can fix this from Leave settings.
access.note.endPlaceholder: e.g. The customer withdrew the request.
access.request.title: Request access to {{name}}
access.request.description: Approvers see this request with your note. Say what you need to do and link the ticket.
access.request.narrowHint: Ask only for what the task needs. The approver can narrow both, never widen them.
access.approve.title: Approve {{name}}'s access to {{company}}?
access.approve.description: {{name}} can then open one session within 24 hours. Their own permissions are still checked on every action.
access.approve.narrowHint: {{name}} asked for {{scope}} for {{length}}. You can narrow either, not widen.
access.reject.title: Reject {{name}}'s request for {{company}}?
access.reject.description: Tell them why, so they know what to do instead.
access.end.title: End {{name}}'s session in {{company}}?
access.end.description: {{name}} loses access on their next action. This cannot be undone; they would need a new request.
access.card.title: Support access
access.card.description: Entering a Company's data needs an approved request. You choose the access and how long you need; an approver can narrow either. Undecided requests expire after 24 hours.
access.card.pending: Waiting for an approver. The request expires at {{at}} if nobody decides.
access.card.approved: Open the session before {{at}}. It works only from this sign-in.
access.card.closed.LAPSED: Nobody decided within 24 hours, so the request expired.
access.card.closed.EXPIRED: The approval window passed before a session was opened.
access.card.closed.SESSION_ENDED: The session from this approval has ended. A new session needs a new request.
access.failure.invalid: The request was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
access.failure.access-restricted: This Company cannot be entered right now.
access.failure.refused: You are not allowed to do this.
access.failure.stale: This changed in the meantime. The list has been refreshed.
access.failure.contract: The response could not be verified. Nothing was assumed.
access.failure.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Check the list before trying again.
access.list.title: Access requests
access.list.approverDescription: Decide on operators' requests to enter a Company and watch the sessions that are open. You cannot decide your own.
access.list.operatorDescription: Your requests to enter a Company and what was decided.
access.list.failed: Access requests could not be loaded
access.empty.review: No requests are waiting for a decision.
access.empty.live: No sessions are open right now.
access.empty.mine: You have not requested access yet.
